description: This file defines inline functions, macros, and external references for managing interrupts on the Xtensa architecture within the Zephyr RTOS. It includes functions to enable, disable, and query interrupt status, as well as configurations for multi-level interrupts.

methods.name: z_xt_ints_on
methods.description: Enables specified interrupts by setting bits in the interrupt enable register.

methods.name: z_xt_ints_off
methods.description: Disables specified interrupts by clearing bits in the interrupt enable register.

methods.name: xtensa_irq_enable
methods.description: Enables a specific interrupt on the Xtensa core.

methods.name: xtensa_irq_disable
methods.description: Disables a specific interrupt on the Xtensa core.

methods.name: arch_irq_lock
methods.description: Locks interrupts and returns a key representing the previous interrupt state.

methods.name: arch_irq_unlock
methods.description: Restores the interrupt state using the provided key.

methods.name: arch_irq_unlocked
methods.description: Checks if interrupts are unlocked based on the key.
